title: Tofu Fettuccine with Tikka Masala Sauce, Zucchini, Peppers & Peas

steps.text: Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.

Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover and bring to a boil over high heat. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. Reserve 1 cup of cooking water before draining; set aside.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel, halve, and small dice onion; trim, seed, and medium dice bell pepper. Place both in a large bowl.
Trim and halve zucchini, then cut crosswise into ¼-inch thick half-moons; add to the bowl with the other veggies.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 4-5 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
Meanwhile, place sugar and spices in the reserved bowl; stir to combine the spice mix.
Peel and mince ginger and garlic; add both to the bowl with the spice mix.
Medium dice the tofu; add to the bowl and toss to coat.
When the veggies are soft, add seasoned tofu to the skillet; continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until fragrant, 1-2 minutes.
Add tomato sauce, peas, and cream to the skillet; stir to combine and bring to a simmer. Once simmering, reduce heat to low and continue to cook until tofu is warmed through, 2-3 minutes more.
Transfer drained pasta to the skillet and toss to combine; add reserved pasta water, a few tablespoons at a time, if necessary, to reach a saucy consistency. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide pasta between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
